summary: Join opted-in membership streams to authoritative page metadata and refresh on projection epoch changes

replay.detail: No replay or projection rebuild is required.

schema.detail: Existing local membership State is unchanged; the stream adds API-only epoch metadata when explicitly selected.

rules.detail: Existing collection authorization and row visibility remain in force.

compatibility.detail: Opted-in snapshot and changes frames carry collection-v1 and authoritative epoch/count/frontier metadata. Legacy frames retain their shapes. Unsupported collection selectors use existing error frames with the exact refusal code. No capability is advertised before typed clients and full acceptance.

recovery.detail: Scoped windows use fresh atomic store pages instead of retaining pre-maintenance cached rows. Repair and rebuild at an unchanged claim index advance the pinned generation and emit a metadata-only frame. Unrelated writes may still suppress unchanged frames.
